nodes.label: RULINGS-R4e.md
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: Successor to RULINGS-R4d.md; given on findings R4-09 and R4-10.

nodes.label: The law's candidate set includes g subshells
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: M: 'absolutely, especially since it strengthens the claim.' The admissibility test q < 2(2ℓ+1) says nothing about ℓ, an empty 5g passes it, and g channels are measured in thirty-six species — excluding g was the extra clause and it is not made.

nodes.label: Register 1414 — the node-free floor as domain statement
nodes.rationale: Verified 106 of 106 with g admitted and failing at eleven steps without it, so the g ruling is what makes it true; it names the class (n − ℓ − 1 = 0) instead of naming the f block.

nodes.label: Register 1403 — Protactinium's L degenerate at zero
nodes.rationale: Stands with g admitted: the 5f floor at Pa is 0 contributed by 5g, and 0 is the positivity of a rather than a rival's constraint.

nodes.label: §34.9 repaired to the 4f opening
nodes.rationale: Every clause is true read of 4f and false at 5f; the error is the word 'any', which generalised a fact about one opening to a block with two, so the smallest repair is to say the paragraph is about the 4f opening.

nodes.label: A figure is a visual aid, not an archive
nodes.author: M
nodes.rationale: M: 'it's a lot of data to put on a page … all figures, table, images, are visual aid representations to further a readers understanding where appropriate.' Standing rule for every volume: the raw stores (COORDINATES.tsv at 104,832 rows, the 61-species levels store) are not seated; a volume carries an instrument-generated illustrating extract instead.

nodes.label: The law walked forward above Z = 108
nodes.rationale: Carrying a = 1.9840594 out of lawrencium and re-fitting nowhere: twelve of twelve blocks right (6d 109–112, 7p 113–118, 8s 119–120), t from 0.0492 to 0.6791, no reset, every row labelled a prediction.

nodes.label: No g block through Z = 125
nodes.rationale: A node-free subshell has p = 0 so ν = n and a drops out entirely: 5g sits at ν = 5 forever, 7d at a = 1.98 sits at 3.03, and for 5g to win a would have to fall below 1 when it has risen monotonically since potassium.

nodes.label: §34.7 and §34.9 define t incompatibly
nodes.rationale: §34.9's t is a fraction of the corridor and cannot exceed 1 while §34.7 measures 1.028 at p and 1.785 at d; testing the entry-point prediction against the wrong definition would manufacture a finding.
